info.text:
Most health plans legally can't make you pay over $12,000.
That's the 2027 out-of-pocket cap for one person's covered in-network care, up from $10,600 in 2026 and $6,350 in 2014.
Premium: what you pay every month to have the plan. Deductible: what you pay before the plan starts to help. Out-of-pocket max: the ceiling.
Premiums never count toward the cap, and most out-of-network care doesn't either.
Sources: HealthCare.gov, HHS/CMS.
News and education, not financial advice.
